decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed two-storey side extension with integral garage, due to its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 50 Great South West Road and compatible with the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties or result in conditions prejudicial to highway safety. On balance, the development is in accordance with Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4, T.1.4 and the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002). It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northeast wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 50 Great South West Road Cranford.

Condition : 7 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on drawing No. SMH263DB shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles in connection with the residential use of the property.
description: Erection of two-storey side extension including side garage on ground floor
